paperTradeTracker.methodology: Underlying stock price only; BUY bullish breakout / SELL bearish breakdown; stop 0.50%, Target 1 1.00% (1:2), Target 2 1.50% (1:3). Paper entries allowed 09:15–10:59 IST; remaining open trades close at the latest completed candle at or before 11:00 IST. If one candle touches stop and target, stop-loss is recorded first. No option premium, brokerage or slippage simulated.
